description: This file defines the VacancyAttachmentDecorator class, which provides an object-oriented wrapper around the VacancyAttachment entity, adding methods to access file content and associate vacancies by ID within the context of the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin.

classes.name: VacancyAttachmentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds additional functionality to the VacancyAttachment entity, including content retrieval and vacancy association.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a VacancyAttachment object.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Retrieves the file content from the VacancyAttachment, converting resource streams to strings if necessary.

methods.name: setVacancyById
methods.description: Associates a Vacancy entity with the VacancyAttachment based on the provided vacancy ID.
